title: Doubly-robust methods for Optimal Treatment Rules
text: drotr package uses doubly-robust methods estimate optimal treatment rules (OTRs). define OTRs use conditional average treatment effects (CATEs). CATE can interpreted expected difference outcome treatment vs placebo. doubly-robust learner used estimate CATE. individuals CATE estimates exceed specified threshold ‘t’ treated OTR. observations assigned treatment OTR, can use various estimands describe rule: (1) proportion treated, (2) overall Average Treatment effect Rule (ATRdATR_d), (3) Average Treatment effect subgroup Recommended Treatment rule (ATRTdATRT_d), (4) Average Treatment effect subgroup Recommended Treatment rule (ATNRTdATNRT_d), (5) difference treatment recommendation subgroups (ATRTd−ATNRTdATRT_d - ATNRT_d). estimated using Augmented Inverse Probability Treatment Weight (AIPTW) estimators. full procedure implemented using nested cross-validation Super Learning.
